# Hash-locked builder for the release workflow: `build` and the setuptools
# backend it runs with --no-isolation, wheels only, so no unpinned package
# code executes while building the published artifacts.
# Regenerate (and review the diff) with:
#   uv pip compile --generate-hashes --python-version 3.11 \
#     --python-platform x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
#     <(echo 'build==1.6.1'; echo 'setuptools==84.0.0') \
#     -o .github/workflows/release-requirements.txt
